title: ws-mixer.v1 control channel messages
description: Strict, test-time-only conformance oracle for the 7 stream-0 control message types defined in docs/OVERVIEW.md §2.7. This schema is NEVER linked into production SDK code — runtime validation is hand-written per SDK. additionalProperties:false is deliberately stricter than the wire's forward-compatibility rule (unknown fields on a known `t` are tolerated at runtime) so that this schema catches field-name typos (e.g. `max_stream` vs `max_streams`) during development and CI.

hello.title: hello
hello.description: Client -> server, the first frame on stream 0, always. OVERVIEW.md §2.7.

v.description: must be 1 and match the ws-mixer.v1 subprotocol

token.description: must equal the Authorization bearer token

max_streams.description: streams this peer will accept; default 64

meta.description: opaque to ws-mixer; delivered to the application before welcome is sent

welcome.title: welcome
welcome.description: Server -> client, reply to hello. OVERVIEW.md §2.7.

max_streams.description: the effective cap = min(client ask, server policy)

ping_timeout.description: MUST be >= 2x ping_interval; the schema can only enforce the floor implied by ping_interval's own floor of 5000. The 2x-of-the-actual-ping_interval cross-field rule is a hand-written runtime check, not expressible here.

meta.description: opaque; the application's answer to hello.meta

ping.title: ping
ping.description: Sent by either side every ping_interval. OVERVIEW.md §2.7, §2.9.

pong.title: pong
pong.description: Sent immediately on ping, echoing id and ts verbatim. OVERVIEW.md §2.7, §2.9.

id.description: must equal the id of the ping being answered

ts.description: must equal the ping's ts verbatim

drain.title: drain
drain.description: Server -> client (and client -> server with reason=client_requested). OVERVIEW.md §2.7, §2.9. `reason` is a closed enum at the protocol level, but an unrecognized value is tolerated at runtime (degrade to maintenance, count) rather than rejected, so this schema intentionally does not use `enum` here -- it accepts any short token string.

reason.description: known values: rollout | overload | id_exhausted | replaced | maintenance | client_requested. Unknown values are tolerated at runtime (treated as maintenance) and are NOT a schema violation.

last_stream_id.description: highest id the server has opened or will open; endpoints MUST NOT increase a previously-sent value

error.title: error
error.description: Connection-fatal; always the last message on the wire before the WS close. OVERVIEW.md §2.7, §2.8.

code.description: one 32-bit space shared by RESET and connection errors; 0x0000-0x0FFF reserved for ws-mixer, >=0x10000000 free for the layer above

message.description: MUST contain at least one number that came off the wire

app.title: app
app.description: Opaque application payload, legal in both directions any time after welcome. OVERVIEW.md §2.7 decision 4.

body.description: opaque to ws-mixer; delivered verbatim to the application
